The image shows soybean leaves with distinct white, powdery patches scattered across the upper leaf surfaces. The patches vary in size from small spots to larger coalescing areas. The leaves remain green but show these chalky white deposits in multiple locations across the canopy. No angular lesions, brown necrosis, or pustules are visible.

This matches Powdery Mildew: white powdery coating on leaves beginning as small patches that coalesce, covering the leaf surface.
